intents_zh: 遮罩 log 裡的 token
code:
import re, os

SECRETS = [os.environ.get('{{secret_var}}','')]
SECRETS = [s for s in SECRETS if s]

def mask(text: str) -> str:
    for s in SECRETS:
        text = text.replace(s, '*'*8)
    text = re.sub(r'(sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{6})[A-Za-z0-9]+', r'\\1***', text)
    return text

print(mask(f"calling api with key={os.environ.get('{{secret_var}}','')} ok"))
